name: Chickpea, Snap Pea & Asparagus Broth with Minted Ricotta Toast
ingredients: 64 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; place in a medium bowl.
Halve snap peas crosswise. Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch pieces. Add both to the bowl with the onion and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, drain and rinse chickpeas.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chickpeas and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 4-5 minutes.
When the chickpeas are done, add veggies to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.

When the veggies are soft, add broth and spices to the pot; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, about 5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl along with ricotta, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Toast bread if desired; spread with half of the minted ricotta (reserve remaining minted ricotta for the soup).
When the soup is done, add the remaining minted ricotta, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide soup between bowls; serve with lemon wedges and toast on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
